name: Ephilim's Pandaemonium
inspire: If there are 2 or more Inspired friendly minions ({icon:minion}), Inspire your leader ({icon:leader}).

reactions.name: Glorious Change
reactions.flavorText: Unpredictable and chaotic are the whims of the Change God.
reactions.rulesText: Immediately after the first Action step of each battle round, pick a friendly minion ({icon:minion}). Inspire that fighter. Then pick a friendly minion ({icon:minion}). Give that fighter a Stagger token.

reactions.name: Power Leech
reactions.flavorText: Ephilim won't hesitate to draw power from a viable source.
reactions.rulesText: Immediately after a friendly minion ({icon:minion}) within 2 hexes of your leader ({icon:leader}) is slain, you can draw 1 Power card.

abilities.name: Summoned Abominations
abilities.trigger: Use this immediately after your last Action step of each round if your leader ({icon:leader}) is not slain.
abilities.flavorText: With a flick of their fingers, Ephilim summons one of their unholy charges back into reality.
abilities.rulesText: Pick a slain friendly minion ({icon:minion}). Raise that fighter and place them in a starting hex in friendly territory. Then inflict damage on that fighter until they vulnerable.

abilities.name: Fires of Change
abilities.trigger: Use this immediately after a friendly fighter's successful ranged Attack.
abilities.flavorText: The multi-hued fires of Tzeentch cause those caught by them to violently mutate.
abilities.rulesText: Give each enemy fighter adjacent to the target 1 warping token. After your opponent's first Action step in the next battle round, remove each warping token from each enemy fighter one at a time. After a fighter's tokens are removed in this way, inflict 1 damage on that fighter. You can only use this ability once per game.

abilities.name: Shared Mutations
abilities.trigger: Use this immediately after your Action step.
abilities.flavorText: The mutability of Tzeentch's daemons is made manifest when the flesh of those nearby begins to mutate wildly.
abilities.rulesText: Inflict 1 damage on each enemy fighter adjacent to any friendly minions ({icon:minion}). You can only use this ability once per game.

playstyle: Five fragile Tzeentch daemons with low health and dodge saves, mostly Move 3, plus a flying Apo'trax and a faster Spawnmaw. Glorious Change Inspires a minion each round but Staggers another, and Ephilim Inspires once two minions are Inspired. Slain minions return through Summoned Abominations, arriving vulnerable, while Power Leech draws Power cards when minions fall near the leader. The warband wins through ranged chip damage, once-per-game bursts that hit clustered enemies and recycled bodies, trading minions for cards while keeping Ephilim alive.
